image_description: A close-up underwater photograph of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rocky, algae-covered substrate. The organism displays an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal armor consisting of eight overlapping calcareous plates embedded in a thick, leathery girdle. The plates are mottled green and brown, blending with the surrounding encrusted rock surface.
